description: This file defines a dynamic configuration class generator for JSON-based providers, including methods for message transformation, URL construction, parameter mapping, and provider info retrieval, tailored for different OpenAI-like models.

classes.name: JSONProviderConfig
classes.description: A dynamically generated configuration class for JSON-based providers, extending either OpenAIGPTConfig or OpenAILikeChatConfig, with methods for message transformation, URL building, and parameter handling.

methods.name: create_config_class
methods.description: Function that generates and returns a custom configuration class based on the provided JSON configuration.
